items.title: The self map given by a section is homotopic to the identity on the associated simplicial object
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-fibre-products-simplicial-object-w-section at source lines 4873-4884: if f : Y to X has a section s and U is the simplicial object built from f by iterated fibre products, then the degreewise self map (s f)^{n+1} is homotopic to the identity, so U is homotopy equivalent to the constant simplicial object X. The proof at source lines 4886-4906 writes the homotopy down: it sets g^0 = id and g^1 = s f, describes the maps through the functor-of-points as sending a tuple together with alpha in Mor([n],[1]) to the tuple with g^{alpha(i)} applied in each slot, and rewrites this as the explicit family h_{n,i} = id^{i+1} times (s f)^{n+1-i}. The author then says that these satisfy the relations of the relations-homotopy lemma and leaves that verification to the reader, pointing to the remark that no further assumption on the category is needed. The substance of the card is therefore the construction and the reformulation; the final relation check is delegated by the author, which the card records rather than hides.
